result.title: Falsifiable Compositional Reasoning in Time Series Forecasting
result.summary: Time series foundation models as well as the language-guided analytical agents achieve strong accuracy on standard chronological benchmarks. However, models that rank highest on historical validation splits often degrade across non-stationary regime transitions. We hypothesise that this gap arises from using historical backtesting as an open-ended search and model-selection objective instead of using it to test pre-specified compositional assumptions. Real-world time series are generated by recurring latent primitives that co-move within finite historical windows. Under strong historical co-movement, chronological holdout error cannot separate predictors that learn invariant couplings among primitives from predictors that fit transient historical correlations. Searching over large pools of architectures, hyperparameters, or chain-of-thought rules further biases selection toward historical shortcuts. Through theoretical analysis and diagnostic experiments on a controlled multi-primitive benchmark and German day-ahead electricity prices, we show that expanding validation search fails to improve out-of-regime accuracy, and that decomposing primitives without an ex-ante falsification test still breaks down when residual correlations shift. Hence, we propose formulating time series forecasting and reasoning around falsifiable compositional hypotheses that combine neural primitive encoders, explicit coupling constraints, and training-calibrated falsification tests.

AI.brief_summary: 论文指出时间序列模型以历史回测作开放式搜索与选型，会在非平稳机制切换后失效，主张围绕「可证伪的组合假设」建模，即神经原语编码器、显式耦合约束与训练期校准的证伪检验相结合，并用理论分析与受控多原语基准、德国日前电价数据做诊断。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「潜在原语耦合假设＋训练期校准的证伪检验」或可为 LVR 中 latent 假设的证据筛选与避免验证集捷径式选择提供方法线索，需核查该检验能否迁移到多模态推理状态。
